business_summary.text: Deepa Jewellers is an organised B2B designer, processor and supplier of hallmarked gold jewellery, specializing in traditional gold waist belts (Vaddanam) and CNC machine cut bangles, operating primarily in Southern India.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin pressure expected to ease as new facility reaches full capacity

guidance.statement: Continued strong demand for B2B jewellery processing and manufacturing
For FY27, ‘28 and ‘29, we expect a CAGR growth of between 40%-45%.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: New Hyderabad manufacturing facility aims to reduce karigar dependency and capture manufacturing margin
Expansion of sales offices in Vijayawada, AP with Chennai, Bangalore & Coimbatore planned

timeline.summary: Deepa Jewellers reported Q1FY27 results with 39% YoY revenue growth to ₹431 Cr and 27% YoY PAT growth to ₹26.8 Cr, driven by strong B2B jewellery demand, though margin pressure from new facility costs moderated PAT gains.

Deepa Jewellers Limited invites investors to a Q2 & H1 FY 2026-27 earnings call on **27 Oct 2026 at 16:00 IST**, led by **Mr. Dev Agarwal (WTD)** and **Mr. G. K. Srinivas (CFO)** via virtual conference.
Deepa Jewellers submitted financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Deepa Jewellers reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹625.62 Cr, up 24.6% YoY, and PAT of ₹37.3 Cr, up 37.1% YoY.
